answer_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  dc.country_name AS country
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS dc
  ON c.country_code = dc.country_code
WHERE
  c.valid_from <= (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
  AND c.valid_end > (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
  AND dc.is_placeholder = FALSE
ORDER BY
  dc.country_name
